name: read_file
description: Read a text file from the workspace.

file_path.description: Relative path of the file to read

name: search_files
description: Search for files and directories inside the workspace.

pattern.description: A pathlib glob pattern such as *.py or test*

directory.description: Relative directory to search from; defaults to .

name: list_directory
description: List files and directories inside the workspace.

name: file_metadata
description: Get safe metadata for a workspace file or directory.

name: search_media
description: Find configured movie and video files without reading their contents.

name_pattern.description: File name glob such as * or *python*

name: list_drives
description: List available drives without reading their contents.

name: list_location
description: List a folder path; locations outside the workspace require approval.

location.description: Absolute path such as Y:\ or a workspace-relative path

name: read_external_file
description: Read a text file by path; outside-workspace reads require approval.

file_path.description: Absolute path or workspace-relative text file path

name: create_file
description: Create a text file inside the workspace.

file_path.description: Relative path of the new file

content.description: Complete contents of the new file

name: delete_file
description: Delete one workspace file after explicit user approval. Directories are not allowed.

file_path.description: Relative path of the exact file to delete

name: rename_file
description: Rename a file or directory inside the workspace.

name: create_directory
description: Create a directory inside the workspace.

directory.description: Relative path of the directory to create

name: git_status
description: Show the current Git status for the workspace repository.

name: git_diff
description: Show Git changes in the workspace repository.

name: git_log
description: Show recent commits from the workspace repository.

limit.description: Number of commits to show, from 1 to 50

name: git_branch
description: List local branches in the workspace repository.

name: git_create_branch
description: Create a local Git branch after user approval.

name: git_commit
description: Commit already staged changes after explicit user approval.

name: git_push
description: Push commits to a Git remote after explicit user approval.

name: git_pull
description: Pull remote changes with fast-forward-only behavior after approval.

name: git_checkout
description: Switch the workspace to an existing Git branch after approval.

name: edit_file
description: Replace the complete contents of a workspace text file.

file_path.description: Relative path of the file to edit

name: request_new_tool
description: Create a human-reviewable proposal for a missing capability. The proposal is not activated automatically.

name.description: Lowercase snake_case name for the proposed tool

capability.description: What the new tool should do

reason.description: Why the current task needs this capability

name: create_workflow
description: Create an approved reusable workflow composed only of existing tools.

tool.description: Name of an existing registered tool

name: run_workflow
description: Run an approved reusable workflow by name.

name: run_command
description: Run a command in the workspace and return its output.

command.description: Command to run in the workspace

name: create_and_register_tool
description: Create, test, validate, and hot-register a new custom Python tool into the agent runtime when a required capability is missing. Once registered, the tool is immediately active and callable in the current session.

name.description: Lowercase snake_case name for the tool function, e.g. calculate_sha256

description.description: Clear description of what the tool does and how the LLM should use it

parameters.description: OpenAI JSON schema object defining the tool arguments (e.g. properties, required)

code.description: Complete Python source code for the tool file, containing a function with the same name

test_code.description: Optional Python test/assertion code to verify that the tool function runs correctly before registering

name: reload_tools
description: Reload and refresh all custom tools from disk into the running agent session.
